# canton_parties (Data Source)

Lists all known parties on a Canton participant node. Results are paginated automatically.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "canton_parties" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `parties` (Attributes List) List of known parties. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parties))

<a id="nestedatt--parties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parties`

Read-Only:

- `is_local` (Boolean) Whether the party is local to this participant.
- `party_id` (String) The party ID.
